name: Tough Hide
desc: +2 maximum HP (one-time).

name: Strong Back
desc: Your carrying capacity is doubled. You have advantage on Athletics checks to lift, drag, or push.

name: Quick Reflexes
desc: +1 to initiative rolls.

name: Steady Hand
desc: +1 to one weapon-attack roll of your choice per short rest.

name: Weapon Grip
desc: Gain proficiency with one martial weapon of your choice.

name: Blade Study
desc: You have studied edged weapons. +1 to attack rolls with slashing or piercing weapons made against a target you have hit already this combat.

name: Blunt Study
desc: You have studied bludgeoning weapons and unarmed combat. When you hit a target with a bludgeoning weapon or unarmed strike, you may forgo damage to give the target disadvantage on its next attack roll before the end of its next turn. Once per short rest.

name: Reach Study
desc: You have studied polearms and spears. Reach weapons in your hands threaten 5 ft. farther for opportunity attacks.

name: Armor Familiarity
desc: Gain proficiency with one armor category (light, medium, or heavy) or with shields.

name: Iron Stance
desc: You have advantage on saves against being knocked prone or shoved.

name: Careful Swing
desc: Once per short rest, when you would hit an ally with a melee attack (through friendly fire, sweeping attacks, etc.), you may choose to miss instead.

name: Unarmored Defense
desc: While wearing no armor and no shield, your AC equals 10 + DEX mod + CON mod.

name: Second Wind Touched
desc: Once per long rest as a bonus action, regain HP equal to 1d6 + your character level (max 10 total).

name: Gritty Endurance
desc: When you take a short rest, you may spend one hit die and regain HP equal to the roll + your CON mod, without using any of the short rest's normal hit dice.

name: Athlete
desc: 5e feat: Athlete. +1 STR or DEX. Standing from prone costs only 5 ft. of movement, climbing does not halve your speed, and you can make running long/high jumps after only a 5 ft. run.

name: Resilient
desc: 5e feat: Resilient. Choose one ability score; increase it by 1 and gain proficiency in saving throws using that ability.

name: Tavern Brawler
desc: 5e feat: Tavern Brawler. +1 STR or CON. Proficient with improvised weapons. Unarmed strikes deal 1d4. When you hit with an unarmed or improvised strike, you may attempt to grapple as a bonus action.

name: Charger
desc: 5e feat: Charger. When you Dash, use a bonus action to make a melee attack or shove. If you moved 10+ ft. straight before the attack, deal +5 damage or push the target 10 ft.

name: Crusher
desc: 5e feat: Crusher. +1 STR or CON. Once per turn, when you deal bludgeoning damage, push the target 5 ft. Crits with bludgeoning give allies advantage on attacks against the target until start of your next turn.

name: Piercer
desc: 5e feat: Piercer. +1 STR or DEX. Once per turn when you deal piercing damage, reroll one damage die. Crits with piercing let you roll one additional damage die.

name: Slasher
desc: 5e feat: Slasher. +1 STR or DEX. Once per turn when you deal slashing damage, reduce the target's speed by 10 ft. Crits with slashing impose disadvantage on the target's attacks until start of your next turn.

name: Tough
desc: 5e feat: Tough. Your HP maximum increases by twice your character level, and by 2 whenever you gain a level thereafter.

name: Mobile
desc: 5e feat: Mobile. +10 ft. speed. When you Dash, difficult terrain doesn't cost extra movement. When you make a melee attack against a creature, you don't provoke opportunity attacks from that creature for the rest of the turn.

name: Sentinel
desc: 5e feat: Sentinel. Creatures provoking an opportunity attack from you have their speed reduced to 0 for that turn. You can attack creatures using Disengage. When a creature within 5 ft. attacks a target other than you, you may use your reaction to make a melee attack against that creature.

name: Great Weapon Master
desc: 5e feat: Great Weapon Master. On a crit or when you drop a creature to 0 HP with a melee weapon, make one melee attack as a bonus action. Before making a melee attack with a heavy weapon you are proficient with, you may take -5 to hit for +10 damage.

name: Polearm Master
desc: 5e feat: Polearm Master. When wielding a glaive, halberd, quarterstaff, spear, or pike, you can make a bonus-action attack with the opposite end (1d4 bludgeoning, same modifiers). Creatures entering your reach provoke opportunity attacks.

name: Shield Master
desc: 5e feat: Shield Master. If you take the Attack action, use a bonus action to shove a creature within 5 ft. with your shield. +2 to DEX saves against effects you can see; if the save halves damage, take no damage on success.

name: Dual Wielder
desc: 5e feat: Dual Wielder. +1 AC while wielding two melee weapons. You can two-weapon fight with non-light melee weapons. You can draw or stow two weapons in the time you'd normally draw one.

name: Heavy Armor Master
desc: 5e feat: Heavy Armor Master. +1 STR. While wearing heavy armor, bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources is reduced by 3.

name: Undying
desc: When you would be reduced to 0 HP, you instead drop to 1 HP. Recharges on a long rest.

name: Warden's Bane
desc: Once per long rest, declare a single attack a Warden's Bane: it automatically critically hits and deals an extra 6d12 force damage.

name: Sharp Mind
desc: +1 to one Intelligence check per short rest.

name: Strong Will
desc: +1 to one Wisdom saving throw per short rest.

name: Perfect Recall
desc: You can perfectly recall anything you have seen or heard within the last hour.

name: Quick Learner
desc: Learning a new tool proficiency takes half the normal downtime.

name: Keen Senses
desc: +1 to Perception checks that use sight or hearing.

name: Keen Mind
desc: 5e feat: Keen Mind. +1 INT. You always know which way is north, the number of hours until sunrise/sunset, and can perfectly recall anything you've seen or heard within the past month.

name: Skilled
desc: 5e feat: Skilled. Gain proficiency in any combination of three skills or tools.

name: Prodigy
desc: 5e feat: Prodigy. Gain one skill proficiency, one tool proficiency, and fluency in one language. Choose one skill you are proficient in and gain expertise in it.

name: Observant
desc: 5e feat: Observant. +1 INT or WIS. Reading lips of a language you know. +5 to passive Perception and passive Investigation.

name: Skill Expert
desc: 5e feat: Skill Expert. +1 to an ability score of choice. Proficiency in one skill. Choose a skill you are proficient in and gain expertise in it.

name: Honeyed Words
desc: +1 to one Persuasion check per short rest.

name: Read the Room
desc: +1 to one Insight check per short rest.

name: Traveler's Tongue
desc: You learn one additional language of your choice.

name: Good First Impression
desc: When first meeting a creature, you may reroll a failed Charisma check made in the first minute of the interaction. Once per creature.

name: Performer
desc: Gain proficiency in Performance, and with one musical instrument or gaming set.

name: Linguist
desc: 5e feat: Linguist. +1 INT. Learn three additional languages. You can create written ciphers that others cannot decode without your key or a DC 20 INT check.

name: Actor
desc: 5e feat: Actor. +1 CHA. Advantage on Deception and Performance checks when trying to pass as someone else. You can mimic voices and sounds you've heard well enough to fool casual listeners (WIS Insight vs. your CHA Deception to see through).

name: Inspiring Leader
desc: 5e feat: Inspiring Leader. Spend 10 minutes speaking to up to six creatures (including you) who can see, hear, and understand you. Each gains temp HP equal to your level + your CHA modifier. A creature can't gain temp HP from this feat again until it finishes a short or long rest.

name: Nimble Step
desc: +5 ft. speed when moving through difficult terrain (once per turn).

name: Forager
desc: When traveling in wilderness, you find enough food and water for yourself each day without a check.

name: Light Sleeper
desc: You are not surprised while conscious, even if asleep. You gain the benefits of a long rest after 6 hours instead of 8.

name: Weather-Hardened
desc: You suffer no ill effects from non-extreme hot or cold weather.

name: Trapfinder
desc: +1 to Perception and Investigation checks to find traps.

name: Alert
desc: 5e feat: Alert. +5 to initiative. You can't be surprised while conscious. Other creatures don't gain advantage on attack rolls against you from being unseen by you.

name: Dungeon Delver
desc: 5e feat: Dungeon Delver. Advantage on Perception and Investigation checks to detect hidden doors and traps. Resistance to trap damage. You can search for traps at normal travel pace.

name: Lucky
desc: 5e feat: Lucky. You have 3 luck points. When you make an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you may spend one luck point to roll an additional d20 and choose which to use. You may also spend a luck point when a creature attacks you to have them roll an extra d20 (you choose which they use). Regain all on a long rest.

name: Durable
desc: 5e feat: Durable. +1 CON. When you roll a hit die to regain HP, treat any roll below your CON modifier as equal to your CON modifier (minimum 1).

name: Drop of Mana
desc: +3 maximum MP (one-time). If you had no MP pool, you gain one.

name: Cantrip-Touched
desc: You learn one cantrip from any class list. Your casting stat for it is your highest mental ability score.

name: Minor Arcanist
desc: You have advantage on Arcana checks made to identify a spell being cast or a common magical effect.

name: Element Dabbler
desc: You gain Novice proficiency in one element of your choice.

name: Arcane Focus
desc: You may use any weapon or unarmed strike as a spellcasting focus.

name: Magic Initiate
desc: 5e feat: Magic Initiate. Choose a class (bard, cleric, druid, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard). Learn 2 cantrips and one 1st-level spell from that class. You can cast the 1st-level spell once per long rest without spending resources.

name: Metamagic Adept
desc: 5e feat: Metamagic Adept. Learn 2 Metamagic options from the Sorcerer's list. Gain 2 sorcery points to use them, regaining all on a long rest.

name: Eldritch Adept
desc: 5e feat: Eldritch Adept. Learn one Eldritch Invocation. If it has a prerequisite, you must meet it.

name: Telepathic
desc: 5e feat: Telepathic. +1 to an INT/WIS/CHA. Speak telepathically to a creature within 60 ft. that shares a language with you. You can cast Detect Thoughts once per long rest without a slot.

name: Telekinetic
desc: 5e feat: Telekinetic. +1 to INT/WIS/CHA. Learn Mage Hand as a cantrip; the hand is invisible. As a bonus action, telekinetically shove a creature or object within 30 ft. (target STR save vs. your spell save DC or moves 5 ft.).

name: Fey Touched
desc: 5e feat: Fey Touched. +1 to INT/WIS/CHA. Learn Misty Step and one 1st-level divination or enchantment spell of your choice. Cast each once per long rest without a slot; you may otherwise cast them by spending slots normally.

name: Shadow Touched
desc: 5e feat: Shadow Touched. +1 to INT/WIS/CHA. Learn Invisibility and one 1st-level illusion or necromancy spell of your choice. Cast each once per long rest without a slot; you may otherwise cast them by spending slots normally.

name: Efficient Caster
desc: Once per short rest, cast a spell of 3rd level or lower for 2 less MP (minimum 1).

name: War Caster
desc: 5e feat: War Caster. Advantage on CON saves to maintain concentration. You can perform somatic components with weapons/shields in your hands. When a hostile creature provokes an opportunity attack, you may cast a cantrip at them (1 action cast time, targets only that creature) instead.

name: Spell Sniper
desc: 5e feat: Spell Sniper. Attack-roll spells you cast double their range. Ignore half and three-quarters cover with attack-roll spells. Learn one attack cantrip from a spell list of your choice.

name: Ritual Caster
desc: 5e feat: Ritual Caster. Choose a class (bard/cleric/druid/sorcerer/warlock/wizard). Acquire a ritual book with two 1st-level ritual spells from that class. You may cast any ritual spell in your book as a ritual.

name: Elemental Focus
desc: Advance one element proficiency by one step (to a maximum of Master through this node).

name: Elemental Adept
desc: 5e feat: Elemental Adept. Choose one damage type: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. Your spells with that damage type ignore resistance to it. Treat 1s on damage dice of that type as 2s. Repeatable — different damage type each time.

name: Oracle's Sight
hint: The blind woman on the mountain trades sight for sight.
desc: You can cast Divination once per long rest without expending MP, and you always know the general nature of a creature's next action.

name: Jack of Trades
desc: Gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

name: Tool Dabbler
desc: Gain proficiency with one artisan's tool, gaming set, or musical instrument.

name: Lucky Penny
desc: Once per long rest, reroll a d20 and take the new result. Must decide before the outcome is revealed.

name: Well-Traveled
desc: You automatically know general facts about any settlement of 500+ people you have visited or heard extensively about.

name: Kitchen-Hand
desc: Gain proficiency with cook's utensils. Meals you prepare take normal time but heal an extra 1 HP per hit die spent during a short rest by those who ate.

name: Chef
desc: 5e feat: Chef. +1 CON or WIS. Cook's utensils proficiency. During a short rest, prepare enough food for up to CON mod + 4 creatures; each restores an extra 1d8 HP when they spend hit dice. During a long rest, bake special treats equal to your prof bonus; a creature that eats one gains temp HP equal to your prof bonus.

name: Crafter
desc: 5e feat: Crafter. Proficiency with three artisan's tools of your choice. Reduce the crafting time and cost of nonmagical items by 20%.

name: Musician
desc: 5e feat: Musician. Proficiency with three musical instruments of your choice. Perform for up to prof bonus creatures during a short/long rest to grant each Inspiration (once per long rest per creature).

name: Frugal Learner
desc: The first Common talent you buy after taking this one costs 0 Talent Points. Can only be taken once.

name: Observant Note
desc: Once per long rest, ask the DM one yes/no question about the immediate scene or a creature in it. The DM answers truthfully or says the answer is unknowable.

name: Soul-Kindler
desc: You gain access to one additional Common Soul Effect of your choice from the base library.

name: Quick Draw
desc: You can draw or stow one weapon during your turn as part of your movement, not requiring an object interaction.

name: Marksman's Eye
desc: +1 to attack rolls with ranged weapons against targets within 30 ft.

name: Defensive Duelist
desc: 5e feat: Defensive Duelist. When wielding a finesse weapon you are proficient with and hit by a melee attack, use your reaction to add your prof bonus to your AC against that attack.

name: Crossbow Expert
desc: 5e feat: Crossbow Expert. Ignore the loading property of crossbows you are proficient with. Being within 5 ft. of a hostile creature doesn't impose disadvantage on your ranged attacks. When you attack with a one-handed weapon, you can attack with a hand crossbow you're holding as a bonus action.

name: Gunner
desc: 5e feat: Gunner. +1 DEX. Firearm proficiency. Ignore firearm loading property. Being within 5 ft. of a hostile creature doesn't impose disadvantage on your ranged attacks.

name: Fighting Initiate
desc: 5e feat: Fighting Initiate. Learn one Fighting Style from the Fighter's list. Can be taken multiple times, learning a different style each time.

name: Grappler
desc: 5e feat: Grappler. +1 STR. Advantage on attacks against creatures you are grappling. Grappling a creature lets you use an action on your subsequent turn to also make it restrained.

name: Mounted Combatant
desc: 5e feat: Mounted Combatant. While mounted: advantage on attacks against unmounted foes smaller than your mount, redirect attacks aimed at your mount to yourself, and if your mount is subject to a DEX save, it takes no damage on a success and half on a fail.

name: Martial Adept
desc: 5e feat: Martial Adept. Learn 2 maneuvers from the Battle Master list. Gain 1 superiority die (d6) to fuel them; regain on a short rest.

name: Sharpshooter
desc: 5e feat: Sharpshooter. Attacking at long range doesn't impose disadvantage. Your ranged attacks ignore half and three-quarters cover. Before making a ranged attack with a weapon you're proficient with, you may take -5 to hit for +10 damage.

name: Mage Slayer
desc: 5e feat: Mage Slayer. When a creature within 5 ft. of you casts a spell, use your reaction to make a melee attack against it. Advantage on saves against spells cast by creatures within 5 ft. of you. When you damage a concentrating creature, it has disadvantage on the concentration save.

name: Savage Attacker
desc: 5e feat: Savage Attacker. Once per turn when you roll damage for a melee weapon attack, you can reroll the weapon's damage dice and use either total.

name: Medium Armor Master
desc: 5e feat: Medium Armor Master. Wearing medium armor doesn't impose disadvantage on Stealth. Medium armor lets you add up to +3 (not +2) of your DEX bonus to AC.

name: Lightly Armored
desc: 5e feat: Lightly Armored. +1 STR or DEX. Gain proficiency with light armor.

name: Moderately Armored
desc: 5e feat: Moderately Armored. +1 STR or DEX. Gain proficiency with medium armor and shields.

name: Heavily Armored
desc: 5e feat: Heavily Armored. +1 STR. Gain proficiency with heavy armor.

name: Weapon Master
desc: 5e feat: Weapon Master. +1 STR or DEX. Gain proficiency with four weapons of your choice.

name: Peerless Athlete
desc: Your speed increases by 10 ft. You have advantage on all Strength and Dexterity checks made outside of combat. You may swap position with a willing ally within 5 ft. as part of your movement, once per turn.

name: Weaponmaster Ascendant
desc: Once per turn when you hit with a weapon attack, you may add half your character level (rounded down) to the damage roll.

name: Scholar
desc: Gain proficiency in Arcana, History, Nature, or Religion (choose one).

name: Focused Learner
desc: You need only half the normal downtime to learn a new language or gain a new tool proficiency.

name: Sage's Advice
desc: When you make an INT check to recall lore, you can choose to succeed if your total roll would be 10 or higher. When you fail such a check, the DM tells you one true related fact you didn't ask for.

name: Iron Mind
desc: You are immune to being charmed by creatures of CR equal to your prof bonus or lower. Advantage on saves against being charmed, frightened, or possessed by higher-CR creatures.

name: Peerless Intellect
desc: You can attempt any INT check untrained without disadvantage. Once per long rest, take 20 on an INT check made outside of combat, treating it as though you rolled a natural 20 for skill purposes.

name: Silver Tongue
desc: When you speak a lie in a language another creature understands, you may substitute your Deception result for its passive Insight to determine if the lie is caught.

name: Disarming Smile
desc: Once per short rest, you may attempt to calm a hostile creature that can see and understand you. It makes a WIS save (DC 8 + prof + CHA); on fail, it will not initiate hostility against you for 1 minute unless attacked.

name: Master Negotiator
desc: You have advantage on Persuasion and Deception checks when the stakes are non-violent (bartering, diplomacy, favors). Prices for goods and services you negotiate are reduced by 10-25% at the DM's discretion.

name: Masked Identity
desc: You can maintain up to three distinct personas (name, mannerism, voice). Detecting a lie through Insight when you are in a persona is at disadvantage, and creatures who know one persona do not automatically recognize you as another.

name: Voice of Command
desc: Once per long rest, issue a one-word command to a creature within 60 ft. that can hear and understand you. It makes a WIS save (DC 8 + prof + CHA) or obeys the command literally, as the Command spell, for 1 round.

name: Tracker's Eye
desc: +1 to Survival checks to track, and to Perception checks to spot ambushes in wilderness terrain.

name: Pack Mule
desc: You can carry rations, water, and light gear for two extra people without impacting your carrying capacity for other purposes.

name: Skulker
desc: 5e feat: Skulker. You can hide when only lightly obscured. Missing a ranged attack while hidden doesn't reveal your position. Dim light doesn't impose disadvantage on your WIS (Perception) checks relying on sight.

name: Poisoner
desc: 5e feat: Poisoner. Poisons you apply ignore poison resistance. Apply poison as a bonus action instead of an action. Craft potent poisons using downtime and 50 gp of materials per dose (DC 15 CON save vs. 2d8 poison + poisoned condition for 1 min).

name: Beast Friend
desc: Beasts of CR 1/4 or lower will not initiate hostility toward you without provocation. You may use an action to attempt to calm a beast within 30 ft. (WIS check vs. its CR × 5).

name: Vagabond
desc: You need only 4 hours of sleep to benefit from a long rest. Once per long rest, take a full short rest in 15 minutes instead of the usual hour.

name: Peerless Survivor
desc: You have resistance to environmental damage (falling, extreme temperatures, drowning, starvation). Once per long rest, when you fail a saving throw, you may reroll it with advantage.

name: Artificer Initiate
desc: 5e feat: Artificer Initiate. Learn one artificer cantrip. Learn one 1st-level artificer spell, castable once per long rest without a slot (INT as spellcasting mod). Gain proficiency with one tool of your choice, which counts as a spellcasting focus for you.

name: MP Conduit
desc: +8 max MP (one-time). Once per long rest as an action, transfer up to 10 MP to a willing creature within 5 ft., or receive that much from them.

name: Spellshaper
desc: You gain 2 additional sorcery points and one additional Metamagic option of your choice. You may spend sorcery points to convert MP at a 1-for-2 rate as a bonus action, once per short rest.

name: Arcane Savant
desc: Your maximum MP increases by 20. Spells of 4th level or lower cost 1 less MP (min 1). You may cast one prepared spell of 3rd level or lower per long rest without expending MP.

name: Arch-Element
desc: Choose one element you have Elemental Focus in. Your spells and effects of that element deal +1d6 damage of that type, and you may treat a natural 1 on any damage die of that type as a natural 6 instead. Repeatable, but only one element per taking.

name: Quartermaster
desc: You can identify the market value of common trade goods and mundane items on sight, within 20% accuracy.

name: Deft Hands
desc: +1 to Sleight of Hand checks. You can palm or pocket a small item as part of another action.

name: Healer
desc: 5e feat: Healer. When you use a healer's kit to stabilize a creature, it also regains 1 HP. As an action, expend a use of a healer's kit to restore 1d6 + 4 + creature's hit dice HP to a creature; once per short rest per target.

name: Merchant
desc: You have advantage on Persuasion checks made to haggle. You can appraise magical goods (rarity, general function) with a 10-minute inspection.

name: Master Crafter
desc: You may craft magic items of Uncommon rarity given appropriate materials (DM discretion). Reduce time and cost for all crafting by an additional 20% (stacks with Crafter for 40% total).

name: Jack of All Master
desc: You may add half your proficiency bonus (rounded down) to any ability check that doesn't already include your proficiency bonus.

name: Peerless Polymath
desc: You have proficiency in every skill and tool. Once per long rest, treat a failed ability check as a success (declared before rolling).

name: Branch Mastery
desc: Choose a Talent branch. All Common and Uncommon talents in that branch cost 1 less Talent Point (minimum 0).

name: Soul-Deepener
desc: You gain access to two additional Common Soul Effects of your choice from the base library, plus one Uncommon effect.

name: Insight of the System
desc: Your Observant Note talent recharges on a short rest instead of a long rest, and you may ask a two-part yes/no question with a single use.

name: Talent Prodigy
desc: When you gain Talent Points from a minor level, gain 1 additional Talent Point that must be spent within 24 hours of the level-up (RP time or real time, DM's call) or is lost.

name: Soul Savant
desc: Reslotting Soul effects costs half the normal SP (rounded up, minimum 1). You may swap one slotted effect during a short rest for free, once per long rest.

name: Meta-Awakened
desc: Once per long rest, gain 3 temporary Talent Points that must be spent within 1 hour. Any commitment they buy is permanent.

name: Shelter of the Faithful
desc: You can perform religious ceremonies. Temples and shrines of your faith will shelter and feed you and your companions, though you are expected to contribute to upkeep.

name: Measured Word
desc: You can perform a brief rite at the start of a conversation. For the next hour, you have advantage on Persuasion and Insight checks against creatures of your faith, and sympathetic neutral parties treat you with respect.

name: Vessel of the Light
desc: You can call upon your faith. Once per long rest, cast Bless, Shield of Faith, or Protection from Evil and Good without expending MP.

name: Voice of the Chapter
desc: Your authority within your faith is recognized. Clergy and lay members of your faith treat your word as near-binding. You may invoke sanctuary in any temple of your faith, and your presence calms consecrated ground.

name: Living Reliquary
desc: You are a conduit of your faith. Once per long rest you may spend an action in prayer to grant all allies within 30 ft. the benefit of a 1-minute Beacon of Hope.

name: Criminal Contact
desc: You have a reliable contact in the underworld who can relay messages and small favors between cities. The contact's capabilities are capped at the DM's discretion.

name: Fence Network
desc: You can reliably sell stolen or questionable goods in any settlement of 500+ people for 60% of market value. You have advantage on checks to locate black markets.

name: Jobs and Favors
desc: You can call in a small crew (3-6 common NPCs) for a single job of DM-approved scope, once per month of in-world time. They are competent at crime but will not fight pitched battles.

name: The Fixer
desc: You can get almost anything in a major city, given 24 hours and appropriate payment. Illegal goods, passage, forged papers, or discreet introductions are within your reach.

name: Whisper-King
desc: You command a criminal network of your own. The DM tracks it as a faction with reach appropriate to your fame. You may issue it broad directives during downtime.

name: Rustic Hospitality
desc: Common folk will generally give you shelter. They will not risk themselves for you, but will hide you from authorities if they can do so safely.

name: Rallying Word
desc: You can rally common folk to minor action. Once per long rest, spend 10 minutes speaking to a group; if your Persuasion exceeds 15, they'll help with a specific task (build, hide, watch, deliver) that doesn't cross their basic sense of safety.

name: Growing Legend
desc: Stories of your deeds travel ahead of you. In any settlement, one commoner recognizes you and offers aid. The scope of the aid grows as your legend does.

name: Folk's Champion
desc: Common folk organize around you. You can raise a militia of 2d10+10 commoners for a single engagement per long rest; they will fight for you until morale breaks (DM discretion).

name: Living Legend
desc: Your name is myth. Once per long rest, invoke your legend: all allies within sight gain +1 to attack, damage, and saves for 1 minute, and hostile creatures of CR 1 or lower must save or be frightened of you for the duration.

name: Position of Privilege
desc: You are treated with respect by nobility and common folk alike, admitted into high society, and welcomed in most civilized settings.

name: Family Reach
desc: You can draw on your family's resources once per month of in-world time for a favor of DM-appropriate scope (a loan of gold, a letter of introduction, a modest security detail).

name: Court Presence
desc: You command deference even from strangers. Advantage on Persuasion and Intimidation checks against nobles, bureaucrats, and well-off merchants. Minor officials will usually bend rules for you.

name: Private Holdings
desc: You have come into property: an estate, business, or garrison that generates modest passive income and houses retainers who will act on your orders within reason.

name: Lord of the Realm
desc: Your authority is backed by real force. The DM runs your holdings as a minor political power. You may command sworn vassals, levy troops in emergency, and your word carries legal weight.

name: Researcher
desc: If you don't know a piece of lore, you often know where it can be found. You have access to libraries, scholars, and sages who can be consulted.

name: Rote Memory
desc: You can perfectly recall anything you have read or been told in the past month. Once per long rest, treat a failed Arcana, History, Nature, or Religion check as a success by invoking a remembered reference.

name: Hidden Libraries
desc: You know the locations of restricted libraries, sealed archives, and private collections across the setting. Once per week of downtime, you can access one to answer a specific lore question (DM provides a true, if partial, answer).

name: Ancient Tongues
desc: You can read any written language with 10 minutes of study, including dead and extinct tongues. You can speak them haltingly after a day of practice.

name: Loremaster
desc: Your knowledge borders on the mythic. Once per long rest, pose a question to the DM about the setting's history or cosmology; they must give a true and substantive answer, limited only by what any mortal scholar could possibly know.

name: Military Rank
desc: You hold a rank, formal or informal. Soldiers loyal to your former cause recognize your authority. You can requisition basic supplies from military outposts of your faction.

name: Campaign Veteran
desc: You can read a battlefield at a glance. +2 to initiative. Once per short rest, give an ally within 30 ft. advantage on their next attack by directing them to the opening.

name: Squad Leader
desc: You can command troops effectively. When you lead soldiers or militia in combat, they gain +1 to attack and morale checks. You can direct up to 10 soldiers as a bonus action.

name: Battlefield Commander
desc: Your tactical sense is near-infallible. Once per long rest, grant all allies within 60 ft. one of: advantage on their next attack, +5 ft. movement for one round, or a reroll of their next failed save.

name: General of the Field
desc: You can lead armies. In large-scale engagements, your side gains significant mechanical advantages (DM translates to the mass-combat system). Enemies recognize you as a warlord and react accordingly.

name: Wanderer
desc: You have an excellent memory for maps and geography. You can always recall the general layout of terrain, settlements, and features you have seen. You find food and water for yourself and up to 5 others daily in wilderness.

name: Wilds-Kin
desc: Beasts of CR 1/4 or lower treat you as non-threatening unless provoked. You have advantage on Survival checks to track or avoid detection in wilderness.

name: Wilds-Called
desc: Once per long rest, summon a beast (CR 1 or lower) that will aid you for 10 minutes before departing. The DM selects a creature appropriate to the terrain.

name: Walker of the Deep Wilds
desc: You can navigate even the most dangerous wilderness unerringly. You and your party cannot be lost in natural terrain, are resistant to environmental damage, and extreme weather does not slow your travel.

name: Spirit of Place
desc: You are recognized by the natural world. Once per long rest, commune with the spirits of a wilderness area (DM answers 3 questions truthfully about its inhabitants, dangers, and recent events).

name: By Popular Demand
desc: You can always find a place to perform. In exchange, you receive free lodging and food of a modest standard, and you often become a local favorite.

name: Crowdpleaser
desc: After a 10-minute performance, up to 20 observers you can see become favorably disposed toward you for 1 hour. Hostile creatures are not affected unless they were already neutral.

name: Stagecraft
desc: You can use performance to mask action. Allies within 30 ft. of you while you perform have advantage on Stealth and Sleight of Hand checks related to the moment. Once per short rest, create a brief distraction that grants an ally an action's worth of concealment.

name: Known Everywhere
desc: Your name is famous across the setting. In any settlement, you are recognized by at least one notable, who will offer modest help. You can draw crowds that number in the hundreds for an evening.

name: Voice of a Generation
desc: You can move a population. A performance of sufficient length can shift a city's mood (DM tracks this in large-scale terms); a performance before a court can earn or lose you an audience with any ruler.

name: Guild Membership
desc: You are a member in good standing. Guild houses of your trade will shelter you and your companions, and you have access to basic trade contacts in most settlements.

name: Journeyman's Hand
desc: You can craft items of your guild's trade at 80% normal cost and 75% time. +2 on checks involving your craft.

name: Masterwork
desc: You can create items of genuine quality. Nonmagical items of your craft are masterwork quality: +1 to attack or AC as appropriate, or unusually durable, or especially valuable (DM discretion).

name: Magic Smith
desc: You can craft uncommon magic items of your trade given time, materials, and a recipe. Costs and time are DM-mediated but you are fully capable.

name: Legendary Maker
desc: Items you forge enter legend. You can create rare and even epic items of your craft given sufficient time and a story-appropriate justification (DM-gated). Your name becomes attached to the work.

name: False Identity
desc: You have a prepared second identity, documents, and a reputation in a specific city. You can maintain it with minor upkeep.

name: Trick of the Trade
desc: Choose one scam at character creation (fortune-telling, quack cures, forged relics). You can perform it reliably to earn 2d6 gp per day in any town, and your Insight checks to see through similar scams have advantage.

name: Second Face
desc: You can prepare and switch between three false identities at will. Creatures who have met one do not automatically recognize you as another; Insight to see through has disadvantage.

name: Confidence Game
desc: You can run long cons. Given one week of setup, you can manipulate a specific target (wealthy noble, merchant guild, modest faction) into giving up a specific resource. The DM adjudicates scope.

name: The Masterwork Lie
desc: You can become anyone. With sufficient time and intelligence-gathering, you can briefly impersonate even specific, well-known figures; those who know them well may be fooled for minutes to hours (DM adjudicates). Lesser figures you can replace entirely.

name: Martial Chassis
desc: You use a d10 hit die. You begin with the armor and weapon proficiencies listed in your role. Your saves are with STR and CON.

name: Extra Attack
desc: When you take the Attack action, you may make one additional weapon attack.

name: Extra Attack (2)
desc: When you take the Attack action, you may make two additional weapon attacks.

name: Extra Attack (3)
desc: When you take the Attack action, you may make three additional weapon attacks.

name: Agile Chassis
desc: You use a d8 hit die. You begin with the armor and weapon proficiencies listed in your role. Your saves are with DEX and INT.

name: Precise Blow (1d6)
desc: Once per turn when you hit a creature with a weapon attack and either have advantage or an ally is within 5 ft. of the target, deal an extra 1d6 damage of the weapon's type.

name: Precise Blow (2d6)
desc: Your Precise Blow damage increases to 2d6.

name: Precise Blow (3d6)
desc: Your Precise Blow damage increases to 3d6.

name: Precise Blow (4d6)
desc: Your Precise Blow damage increases to 4d6.

name: Precise Blow (5d6)
desc: Your Precise Blow damage increases to 5d6.

name: Arcane Chassis
desc: You use a d6 hit die. You begin with the proficiencies listed in your role. Your saves are with CON and INT. You gain a spellcasting ability (your class subtree specifies which stat and what list).

name: MP Pool
desc: You have an MP pool of 10 + your casting modifier. Spend MP to cast spells per the standard MP cost table.

name: MP Expansion I
desc: Your MP maximum increases by 15.

name: MP Expansion II
desc: Your MP maximum increases by 20.

name: MP Expansion III
desc: Your MP maximum increases by 25.

name: Divine Chassis
desc: You use a d8 hit die. You begin with the proficiencies listed in your role. Your saves are with WIS and CHA. You gain a spellcasting ability (your class subtree specifies which stat and what list).

name: MP Pool
desc: You have an MP pool of 10 + your casting modifier. Spend MP to cast spells per the standard MP cost table.

name: MP Expansion I
desc: Your MP maximum increases by 15.

name: MP Expansion II
desc: Your MP maximum increases by 20.

name: MP Expansion III
desc: Your MP maximum increases by 25.

name: Support Chassis
desc: You use a d8 hit die. You begin with the proficiencies listed in your role. Your saves are with DEX and CHA.

name: Inspiration (d6)
desc: You have Inspiration dice (d6). As a bonus action, grant one to an ally within 30 ft. who can hear you. They may add it to any one check, attack, or save in the next minute. You have a number equal to your prof bonus, regained on a long rest.

name: Inspiration (d8)
desc: Your Inspiration dice become d8s.

name: Inspiration (d10)
desc: Your Inspiration dice become d10s.

name: Inspiration (d12)
desc: Your Inspiration dice become d12s.

name: Specialist Chassis
desc: You use a d8 hit die. You begin with the proficiencies listed in your role. Your saves are with CON and INT. You gain a spellcasting-adjacent ability (your class subtree specifies the shape).

name: Flex MP Pool
desc: You have an MP pool of 8 + your choice of INT, WIS, or CHA modifier. Spend MP for spells, invocations, or infusions per your class subtree.

name: MP Expansion I
desc: Your MP maximum increases by 15.

name: MP Expansion II
desc: Your MP maximum increases by 20.

name: Barbarian Initiate
desc: You draw on the primal fury of the barbarian tradition. Picking this node unlocks further Barbarian features. Chassis role: Frontliner (d10, martial proficiencies, STR+CON saves). A character of another role may still take Barbarian features, but will lack the chassis.

name: Rage
desc: As a bonus action, enter Rage: advantage on STR checks and saves, bonus damage on melee STR attacks, resistance to bludgeoning/piercing/slashing. Lasts 1 min. Uses per long rest and bonus damage scale with GTO level: 2 uses + 2 damage at GTO 5, 3 uses at 15, 4 at 30, 5 at 60, 6 at 85, unlimited at 100. Bonus damage: +2 at 5, +3 at 45, +4 at 80.

name: Unarmored Defense
desc: While not wearing armor, your AC equals 10 + DEX mod + CON mod. You may use a shield. If you wear armor, this feature does not apply.

name: Reckless Attack
desc: When you make your first attack on your turn, you may attack with advantage; attack rolls against you have advantage until your next turn.

name: Danger Sense
desc: Advantage on DEX saves against effects you can see (traps, spells).

name: Fast Movement
desc: +10 ft. speed while not wearing heavy armor.

name: Feral Instinct
desc: Advantage on initiative. If you are surprised at combat start but not incapacitated, you may act normally on your first turn if you enter Rage before anything else.

name: Brutal Critical
desc: You roll one additional weapon damage die when determining extra damage for a critical hit with a melee attack. At GTO 65, this becomes two additional dice; at 85, three.

name: Relentless Rage
desc: If you drop to 0 HP while raging and don't die outright, make a DC 10 CON save. On success, drop to 1 HP instead. DC increases by 5 each time until a long rest.

name: Persistent Rage
desc: Your rage ends only if you fall unconscious or choose to end it. Rage uses now recharge on a short rest.

name: Indomitable Might
desc: If your total for a STR check is less than your STR score, you may use your STR score in place of the total.

name: Path of the Beast
desc: Your rage draws on a bestial nature. When you rage, you grow natural weapons of your choice: bite (1d8 piercing + 1d10 temp HP once/turn), claws (1d6 slashing, extra attack when you Attack), or tail (1d8 piercing, 10 ft. reach, reaction +1d8 AC).

name: Bestial Soul
desc: Your natural weapons count as magical. When you finish a short rest, choose one: swim speed = walking, climb speed = walking, or jump distance x3.

name: Infectious Fury
desc: When you hit a creature with a natural weapon while raging, you may force a WIS save (DC 8 + prof + CON). On fail, choose: they use their reaction to attack another creature they can see; or they take 2d12 psychic damage. Uses = prof bonus per long rest.

name: Call the Hunt
desc: When you rage, choose up to CON mod allies within 30 ft. They gain 5 temp HP and advantage on STR checks for the duration. Once per long rest.

name: Path of the Totem Warrior
desc: You are a spirit-walker. Choose a totem spirit at purchase: Bear (resistance to all non-psychic damage while raging), Eagle (dash as bonus action while raging), or Wolf (allies within 5 ft. have advantage against enemies you can see while raging).

name: Aspect of the Beast
desc: Choose a totem permanent gift: Bear (carrying capacity doubled; advantage on STR checks to move objects), Eagle (see clearly at 1 mile; dim light doesn't impose Perception disadvantage), or Wolf (track at fast pace; stealthy pace at normal travel speed).

name: Spirit Walker
desc: You can cast Commune with Nature as a ritual. When you do, a spirit beast of your totem appears and brings you the information.

name: Monk Initiate
desc: You train in the disciplined martial arts of a monastic tradition. Picking this node unlocks further Monk features. Chassis role: Striker (d8, DEX-based, light/medium armor and martial weapons). A character of another role may still take Monk features, but will lack the chassis.

name: Martial Arts
desc: Your unarmed strikes and monk weapons may use DEX instead of STR. When you take the Attack action with an unarmed strike or monk weapon, you can make one unarmed strike as a bonus action. Martial arts die scales with GTO level: d4 at 5, d6 at 25, d8 at 55, d10 at 85.

name: Monk Unarmored Defense
desc: While not wearing armor and not using a shield, your AC equals 10 + DEX mod + WIS mod.

name: Ki
desc: You gain ki points equal to your character level (max 20), regained on a short rest. Spend 1 ki to: Flurry of Blows (2 unarmed strikes as bonus action), Patient Defense (Dodge as bonus action), or Step of the Wind (Disengage/Dash as bonus action, jump doubled).

name: Unarmored Movement
desc: +10 ft. speed while unarmored. At GTO 45, you can move along vertical surfaces and liquids without falling. +5 ft. speed per step: 10 at GTO 10, 15 at 45, 20 at 70, 25 at 90.

name: Deflect Missiles
desc: When hit by a ranged weapon attack, use your reaction to reduce the damage by 1d10 + DEX + character level. If reduced to 0, catch the missile; spend 1 ki to make a ranged attack with it (martial arts die + DEX, range 20/60).

name: Slow Fall
desc: When you fall, you may use your reaction to reduce the damage by 5 x your character level.

name: Stunning Strike
desc: When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, spend 1 ki to force a CON save (DC 8 + prof + WIS) or be stunned until the end of your next turn.

name: Evasion
desc: On a DEX save for half damage, you take no damage on success and half on failure.

name: Diamond Soul
desc: Proficiency in all saving throws. Spend 1 ki to reroll a failed save.

name: Empty Body
desc: Spend 4 ki as an action to become invisible for 1 minute, with resistance to all damage except force.

name: Way of the Ascendant Dragon
desc: You learn draconic. You can speak with any creature that speaks Draconic.

name: Breath of the Dragon
desc: Choose a damage type (acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison). When you take the Attack action, replace one attack with a breath: 20-ft. cone or 30-ft. line, DEX save (DC 8 + prof + DEX), damage equal to 2 x martial arts dice on fail, half on success.

name: Elemental Infusion
desc: You may change the damage type of your unarmed strikes and monk weapon attacks to your chosen breath damage type. Attacks that deal this damage ignore resistance to that type (but not immunity).

name: Aspect of the Wyrm
desc: Spend 3 ki as a bonus action to manifest an aura for 1 minute: either Frightful Presence (creatures within 10 ft. make WIS save vs. frightened until end of their next turn, save each turn) or Elemental Shield (allies within 10 ft. have resistance to your chosen damage type).

name: Ascendant Aspect
desc: Darkvision 60 ft. Your breath weapon deals additional damage equal to your martial arts die. Once per short rest when you drop a creature to 0 HP, you may regain hit points equal to your character level + CON.

name: Way of the Open Hand
desc: You master the techniques of the Open Hand. When you hit with Flurry of Blows, impose one effect per strike: push 15 ft., knock prone, or impose disadvantage on the target's next attack.

name: Wholeness of Body
desc: As an action, regain HP equal to 3 x your character level. Once per long rest.

name: Tranquility
desc: After a long rest, gain Sanctuary (DC 8 + prof + WIS) until your next long rest or until you attack.

name: Quivering Palm
desc: Spend 3 ki to set up lethal vibrations in a creature you hit with an unarmed strike. At any time within the next prof bonus days, use an action to end it: CON save (DC 8 + prof + WIS) or 10d10 necrotic damage; half on success.

name: Wizard Initiate
desc: You are a student of the arcane arts. Picking this node unlocks further Wizard features. Chassis role: Caster (d6, INT-based, mental saves, MP pool from your role). A character of another role may still take Wizard features, but will lack the chassis.

name: Spellbook
desc: You own a spellbook. INT is your spellcasting ability. You begin with 6 1st-level wizard spells; you may prepare a number of spells equal to INT + character level each day. You may transcribe additional wizard spells into your spellbook with time and gold.

name: Arcane Recovery
desc: Once per day, during a short rest, recover MP equal to half your character level (rounded up), minimum 1.

name: Ritual Casting
desc: Any wizard spell in your spellbook that has the ritual tag can be cast as a ritual without expending MP, even if you haven't prepared it.

name: Spell Mastery
desc: Choose a 1st- and a 2nd-level spell from your spellbook. You can cast them at their base level without expending MP.

name: Signature Spells
desc: Choose two 3rd-level spells in your spellbook as signature spells. They are always prepared and you can cast each at 3rd level once per short rest without expending MP.

name: School of Evocation
desc: You specialize in destructive magic. Transcribing evocation spells into your spellbook costs half the normal time and gold.

name: Sculpt Spells
desc: When you cast an evocation spell that affects other creatures, choose a number equal to 1 + its level. They automatically succeed on their saves against the spell and take no damage if the spell would deal damage.

name: Potent Cantrip
desc: When a creature succeeds on a save against a cantrip of yours that deals damage, they still take half damage.

name: Empowered Evocation
desc: Add your INT modifier to one damage roll of any evocation spell you cast.

name: Overchannel
desc: When you cast an evocation spell of 1st-5th level that deals damage, deal max damage. Each additional use within a long rest deals 2d12 necrotic to you per spell level cast. Clears on long rest.

name: School of Divination
desc: You specialize in seeing. Transcribing divination spells costs half the normal time and gold.

name: Portent
desc: After a long rest, roll 2d20 (3d20 at GTO 70). Record them. You may replace any attack roll, save, or ability check (made by you or a creature you can see) with one of these rolls. Once used, the roll is spent.

name: Expert Divination
desc: When you cast a divination spell of 2nd level or higher, regain MP equal to one level lower than that spell's level (max 5 MP).

name: Cleric Initiate
desc: You serve a divine power. Picking this node unlocks further Cleric features. Chassis role: Divine (d8, WIS-based, light/medium armor and shields, MP pool from your role). A character of another role may still take Cleric features, but will lack the chassis.

name: Divine Spellcasting
desc: WIS is your spellcasting ability. You prepare a number of cleric spells equal to WIS + character level each morning from the cleric spell list.

name: Channel Divinity
desc: You channel divine energy. You have one use per short rest (two at GTO 30, three at 90). Spend it to invoke an effect granted by your Divine Domain, or Turn Undead (10 ft./level radius, WIS save vs. DC 8 + prof + WIS, affected creatures must flee for 1 min).

name: Destroy Undead
desc: Turned undead of CR equal to or less than a threshold are destroyed instead of turned. Threshold increases with GTO level: 1/2 at 25, 1 at 40, 2 at 55, 3 at 70, 4 at 85.

name: Divine Intervention
desc: As an action, implore your deity's intervention. Roll d100; on a roll equal to or less than your character level, the DM chooses an appropriate intervention. On any roll, you cannot use again until long rest; on success, not until 7 days have passed.

name: Life Domain
desc: You serve a god of life. Gain proficiency with heavy armor. Your Domain Spells (Bless, Cure Wounds at 1st; Lesser Restoration, Spiritual Weapon at 3rd; etc.) are always prepared and don't count against your prepared spells.

name: Disciple of Life
desc: When you cast a spell of 1st level or higher that restores HP, the creature regains additional HP equal to 2 + the spell's level.

name: Preserve Life
desc: Channel Divinity option: as an action, allocate 5 x character level HP to creatures within 30 ft. No one may exceed half their max. Doesn't affect undead or constructs.

name: Blessed Healer
desc: When you cast a spell of 1st level or higher that restores HP to another creature, you regain HP equal to 2 + the spell's level.

name: Supreme Healing
desc: When you cast a spell that restores HP by rolling dice, treat each die as its maximum value.

name: War Domain
desc: You serve a god of battle. Gain proficiency with martial weapons and heavy armor. Domain spells are always prepared (Divine Favor, Shield of Faith; Magic Weapon, Spiritual Weapon at 3rd; etc.).

name: War Priest
desc: When you use the Attack action, you may make one weapon attack as a bonus action. Uses equal to WIS mod (minimum 1), regained on a long rest.

name: Guided Strike
desc: Channel Divinity option: after making an attack roll, add +10 to the roll. Can turn a miss into a hit after seeing the roll.

name: Avatar of Battle
desc: Resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources.

name: Rogue Initiate
desc: You are a rogue, a specialist in stealth, trickery, and the sudden knife. Picking this node unlocks further Rogue features. Chassis role: Striker (d8, DEX-based, light/medium armor, Precise Blow scaling damage). A character of another role may still take Rogue features, but will lack the chassis.

name: Sneak Attack Mastery
desc: Your signature attack is the Rogue's strike. If you have Striker's Precise Blow, treat your bonus damage die as one size larger (d6 becomes d8, d8 becomes d10, etc.). If you do not have Precise Blow, you may gain its base effect (+1d6 damage on a qualifying attack) through this node.

name: Cunning Action
desc: On each of your turns, you may use a bonus action to Dash, Disengage, or Hide.

name: Thieves' Cant
desc: You know Thieves' Cant, a secret mix of dialect, jargon, and code. Only another who knows Thieves' Cant can decode it.

name: Expertise
desc: Choose two skills you are proficient in. Double your proficiency bonus in them. Repeatable at GTO 30 for two more.

name: Uncanny Dodge
desc: When an attacker you can see hits you with an attack, use your reaction to halve the damage.

name: Rogue Evasion
desc: On a DEX save for half damage, you take no damage on success and half on failure.

name: Reliable Talent
desc: When you make an ability check that uses your proficiency bonus, treat any d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10.

name: Slippery Mind
desc: Gain proficiency in WIS and CHA saving throws.

name: Stroke of Luck
desc: When you make an attack roll that misses or an ability check that fails, you can turn it into a hit or a success. Once per short rest.

name: Thief
desc: You specialize in traditional thievery. Climbing no longer costs extra movement, and you can make running long/high jumps after moving only 5 feet on foot.

name: Fast Hands
desc: You may use your Cunning Action bonus action to make a Sleight of Hand check, use thieves' tools to disarm a trap or open a lock, or use an object.

name: Supreme Sneak
desc: You have advantage on Stealth checks if you move no more than half your speed on the same turn.

name: Thief's Reflexes
desc: On the first round of combat, take two turns: one at your initiative and one at initiative - 10.

name: Assassin
desc: You specialize in killing. Gain proficiency with the disguise kit and poisoner's kit.

name: Assassinate
desc: You have advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't acted yet in combat. Any hit you score against a creature that is surprised is a critical hit.

name: Infiltration Expertise
desc: You can establish a false identity over 7 days of work and 25 gp per day. You can adopt an identity you have established with extreme fidelity.

name: Death Strike
desc: When you hit a surprised creature, it makes a CON save (DC 8 + prof + DEX). On fail, the damage is doubled.
